title: Proposed scale versus real experiment
prompt: Generate one complete 16:9 historical documentary explanatory landscape/document in the OWNER-APPROVED pen-and-charcoal watercolor style of image1. Vast Greenland interior snow landscape occupies 85 percent of the frame, a tiny ONE-LEVEL civil research-camp access hatch and one modest period cargo sled establish how small an actual research station is against the ice sheet. No giant base, military hardware, network, mapped operational positions, deep shafts, borders, routes or site plans. A small integral flat paper annotation uses EXACTLY these three short lines: 'PROPOSED AREA'; 'Approx. 135,000 km2'; 'Never built'. This is an unbuilt historical proposal area discussed in narration; the landscape is not a scaled or surveyed footprint and must have no invented mapped boundary. Complete drawing, blue-white snow, restrained ink, natural off-white paper, no decorative panels or empty placeholders. NO yellow highlighting, underline, marker, circle, loupe, glow, HUD, stamps or signatures. All emphasis is added later in Resolve.
